claim: Blind reproduction of the inferred reverse-consistent episode discriminator. Read analyses/M695_spec.md sections 1-4 and 11-14 only (Rev 1.2 final). Do NOT read tools/reverse_mask.py, tools/reverse_tau0.py, tools/reverse_speed_concordance.py, analyses/M698_episode_list.json or the reverseInference block of summary_arrays.json. Data: drive_master.csv (canonical clean = ens_outlier_v2 and ens_invalid not True; 663 such drives with raw files), raw/*.csv (names with spaces map to master keys by digits), cadence_regime.csv. Frozen parameters: tau0 = 45.765625 N.m, cap 15 km/h, standstill 1 s, k = 2, caps (duration <= 120 s, >= 2 moving samples, vmax >= 2 km/h), regen window 3 s, gap factor 3. Series: '[VCM] Target Motor Torque' (commanded torque) on its own sample times; speed = '[VCM] Vehicle Speed' where the column exists in the file, else the standard OBD speed column 'Швидкість автомобіля (km/h)'; both aligned to the torque sample times by nearest-previous within 1500 ms, no interpolation, speed range 0..260. Report, per speed source (VCM / OBD) the number of analysable drives, the number of REV_CAND episodes (primary rule) with the drive file and the episode start time (seconds from the first timestamp), and the REV_CAND episode count over the one-at-a-time grid: cap 10 and 20, standstill 0.5 and 2 s, k 1 and 3, tau0 x 0.5 and x 2.
tolerance: episode list: same drives and start times within 2 s expected; grid counts: within 15 % or 3 episodes, whichever is larger; V3 onsets/hits within 5 %
also: List any ambiguity of the spec that changes a number (onset sample definition, standstill duration measurement, aligned-speed zero/NaN handling, REGEN_TO_STOP interplay). Do not tune to match; report disagreements as they are.
